blocks.text: 401 15991 THRIFT AVENUE South Surrey White Rock White Rock V4B 2M9

parts.t: Welcome to THE ARCADIAN! This fully renovated 2 Bed, 2 Bath suite features an open plan with vaulted ceilings and oversized windows in the living room. Enjoy unparalleled privacy with no shared walls and bedrooms on opposite sides. This sun-soaked condo is a short distance from the beach, schools, parks, shopping, restaurants, recreation centers, a senior activity center, and Peace Arch Hospital. The proactive Strata offers a comfortable guest suite, workshop, and renovated common room. Includes 1 storage locker and 1 secure undercover parking space. Renovations include custom cabinets, new light fixtures, ceiling fans, baseboard heaters, flooring, counters, and a soaker tub. No size restrictions for dogs! Rare in South Surrey!
